description: On-delay, off-delay or pulse timer (and their inverted versions), driven by the block's enable. The output is held as a level and the elapsed time counts in the chosen unit.

activation.text: Runs every pass, also when its enable is off: a disabled timer sees a false signal, so an off-delay or a pulse finishes on its own and an on-delay resets.

enable.description: The signal the timer acts on.

eno.description: The timer's output level: true after the on-delay, during a pulse, or until the off-delay ends. Put it on another block's enable to gate that block.

outputs.description: The time that has elapsed, in the chosen unit.

options.description: The output turns on after the preset time.
The output turns off after the preset time.
The output is on for the preset time.

fields.description: The unit of the preset and of the elapsed time.
The preset time, in the chosen unit. A wired preset wins over the one in the body.
